'''Bob Madison''' was a playtester of the [[Premiere Two-Player Introductory Game]]; the credits page of its rules booklet lists him among the playtesters, separately from [[Will Madison]].<ref name="2p-credits">[https://www.hasbro.com/common/instruct/Star_Wars_Customizable_Card_Game.PDF Introductory Two-Player Game Rules Booklet], Decipher / Parker Brothers (1995), credits page. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261015192404/https://www.hasbro.com/common/instruct/Star_Wars_Customizable_Card_Game.PDF Internet Archive]</ref> A fan list of anagrammed Decipherians gives the Madison behind [[Imperial Trooper Guard Dainsom]] as "[Bob/Will] Madison" and does not say which of the two is meant.<ref name="anagrams">[https://www.geocities.ws/plarathas/anagrams.html Anagramed Decipherians], Corellian Engineering Corporation fan site (geocities.ws/plarathas). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261012174750/https://www.geocities.ws/plarathas/anagrams.html Internet Archive]. Mirrors: [https://www.oocities.org/collegepark/plaza/9433/anagrams.html oocities.org] (Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008200413/https://www.oocities.org/collegepark/plaza/9433/anagrams.html Internet Archive]); reocities (Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20160406045459/http://www.reocities.com/CollegePark/plaza/9433/anagrams.html Internet Archive]). Entry: "[Bob/Will] Madison"</ref><ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], Players Committee, p. 200. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009141805/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
